subject: biology

hotspots.label: Membrane sac
hotspots.description: The membrane wrapping that holds the stored contents.

hotspots.label: Water and salts
hotspots.description: The mostly-water filling that stores materials and presses outward.
hotspots.function: Stores water and pressing the cell outward.

hotspots.label: Central vacuole (plant)
hotspots.description: The large central vacuole typical of plant cells that fills most of the space.
hotspots.function: Provides storage and water pressure that holds the plant upright.

hotspots.label: Small vacuoles (animal)
hotspots.description: The smaller vacuoles found in animal cells used for moving materials.
hotspots.function: Store and move materials in animal cells.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette beneath the model, no floor grid, no scene props. The organelle floats large and centered, lit with soft neutral studio light (no rim glow, no bloom, no emissive anywhere). Clean stylized-specimen quality - museum-model cross-section caps, never gore. COLOR IS RESTRAINED: the organelle reads as a calm warm-paper specimen; each structural part is modeled in a muted near-neutral shade (warm taupe, pale vanilla, soft slate), never a saturated legend color. Strong saturated color is reserved entirely for the small flat-colored hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. Interior fluid (if any) is softly translucent but not glassy; cross-section cuts are clean flat museum caps. No emissive channels anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a large rounded vacuole as the star of the model, shown in a clean cutaway within a plant cell slice. The vacuole fills most of the interior; inside, a soft bluish translucent water fill with a few dissolved-salt dots and a small pigment patch. A faint arrow shows the outward water pressure (turgor) pressing against the cell wall edge. A smaller example vacuole sits off to the side labelled for animal cells. Warm-paper palette, muted, translucent but not glassy. Named nodes: CentralVacuole, WaterFill, TurgorArrows, AnimalVacuoleSmall. Budget 10-14k.
